newsitem.title: UK: Schroders jump after agency cross.
newsitem.headline: Schroders jump after agency cross.

text.p: Shares in Schroders Plc jumped on Friday after an agency cross -- where a brokerage matches a buy and sell order from two different clients -- was executed at the offer price, dealers said.
Shares in the investment banking group, which have been boosted in recent months by persistent bid speculation, rose 47-1/2p to 15.22-1/2 stg by 1200 GMT, a record high.

The agency cross was executed at 15.10 stg when the best bid and ask price on the London Stock Exchange's SEAQ trading system was 14.90 and 15.10 stg respectively. This suggested strong demand for the shares, dealers said.
Dealers said that recent sellers of the stock were now taking a back seat. "We have seen the sellers dry up and now the stock is having a good run," said one market maker.
